description: Na₃SiCBiO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.67 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.74 Å. Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.68 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond lengths. Bi is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.63 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one C atom to form distorted ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂SiBi tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one C, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one C, and one Bi atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Si, and one Bi atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Si, and one Bi atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂SiBi tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Si, and one Bi atom.
